newsitem.title: RUSSIA: FORECAST - Russia October inflation 1.5 pct - minister.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Russia October inflation 1.5 pct - minister.

text.p: Russian inflation will quicken to 1.5 percent in October from 0.3 percent in September, Economy Minister Yevgeny Yasin said on Wednesday, adding that seasonal factors were behind rising prices.
"We are not unduly concerned about this," he said.
Russian consumer prices shrank by 0.2 percent in August -- the first non-inflationary month since reforms began in 1992.
Yasin's forecast would put inflation at its highest level since May, when it reached 1.6 percent.
Yasin said that traditionally August saw the least inflation in consumer prices, while October and November saw the sharpest price rises.
